sections.heading: What Is APEDA License Registration and How to Apply Online?
paragraphs: Are you into the business of exporting agricultural and processed food products from India? If yes, APEDA License Registration is mandatory for you. The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) is a government organization that facilitates and promotes the export of scheduled agricultural products. This information by Services Plus provides everything you need to know about online APEDA license registration, including the APEDA registration fees in India, benefits, process, and frequently asked questions.

APEDA License Registration is a compulsory registration for all exporters of scheduled products under the APEDA Act. Fruits, vegetables, meat, poultry, dairy products, and different kinds of processed foods are included in this product list. An array of benefits, such as finance, training, and exposure to international markets would be available to the registered exporters.

In case you are interested in exporting agricultural or processed food items, Online APEDA Registration Certification is the gateway to government recognition as an exporter through the Services Plus website.
This online APEDA registration brings benefit to exporters in several ways:
Legally authorize the export of scheduled products
Access to all government schemes and incentives
Eligibility to participate in many export promotion programs
